svg.text: UNIVERSE MAP · FIGURE 4
From catalog to a frame
The path the packed layers actually follow. Velocity-grid scale is a separate, open question.
Fetch
CF4 table2 (55,877) and groups (38,053), Tully et al. 2023, ApJ 944, 94.
Fetched 2026-11-01 from the CfA VizieR host vizier.cfa.harvard.edu
(viz-bin/asu-tsv) after cdsarc and edd.ifa.hawaii.edu returned HTTP 502.
2MRS, Huchra et al. 2012, via HEASARC: 43,496 usable redshifts.
SDSS DR17 and DESI DR1 BGS, local copies, kept at z < 0.0655.
HYG v4.2 (CC BY-SA 4.0). Local Group from McConnachie 2012.
Planet elements: JPL/Standish, valid 1800–2050.
Checks recorded with the extracts
Supergalactic rotation against CF4 SGL/SGB: median 0.305 arcsec, 55,877 galaxies.
2MRS CMB frame: 369.82 km/s toward galactic (264.021°, 48.253°); 1,103 rows dropped.
CF4 Dist and the distance modulus agree to a median relative 1.2×10⁻⁴.
These checks live in data/catalogs/PROVENANCE.md. They were not repeated here.
Coordinates and units
Catalog cartesians are SGX, SGY, SGZ in Mpc/h with h = 0.75.
CF4: d[Mpc] = 10^((DM−25)/5), then × h. Redshift rows: d[Mpc/h] = cz/100.
Stars: equatorial parsecs, rotated into that frame. The shell is a direction.
Local Group: Galactic (l, b, distance) through the matrix in localgroup.json.
Planets: ecliptic au, then the ecliptic-to-supergalactic matrix in the file.
Artifacts
Little-endian .bin plus a JSON offset table. Arrays align to 8 bytes.
Galaxy positions are int16 × 0.02 Mpc/h. Milky Way positions are int16 × 0.001 kpc.
stars.bin 370 kB · galaxies.bin 3.2 MB · milkyway.bin 1.7 MB.
localgroup.json, dipole.json, and solarsystem.json stay as JSON.
The host flow mesh stays in the page. cf-meta-extract.json is the palette extract.
Draw
loader.js fetches the pair, or reads an inlined script tag.
addon.js setLevel rescales every layer and turns the others off.
Points use a custom shader. gl_PointSize follows depth, inside a clamp.
Labels are CSS2D text. No collision library is in the build.
three.js 0.160.0 is loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net unless --vendor-three is set.
Unresolved · CF4 velocity grids
Two notes describe different products. Neither factor is a global scale.
IP2I 64³ page, summarized 2026-11-01: axes stored (SGZ, SGY, SGX), multiply speeds by 52.
Build note, 2026-11-06: index vel[component, iSGX, iSGY, iSGZ]; |v| about 48.6× below km/s.
galaxies.json says basin tags were recomputed from CF4_new_128-z008_velocity.fits.
That sentence is the file’s. The index order of that integration was not re-checked here.
Catalog cartesians and velocity-grid layout are different objects. · Sources: PROVENANCE.md, galaxies.json, RESEARCH-AND-RENDERING.md
